trigger_condition.memory_trigger: non-contiguous sliced tensor view used as out argument
trigger_condition.concrete_constraints: Input operands are float 256x256 matrices on Apple MPS; the out argument is a sliced non-contiguous view of a larger tensor.

bug_oracle.signal: The sliced out tensor content is identical before and after the matmul and differs from the CPU reference result.

harness_strategy.input_mutation: Create out tensors as sliced views of larger contiguous tensors to produce non-contiguous layouts.
harness_strategy.tensor_construction: Allocate a larger contiguous tensor and slice it to use as the matmul out argument; keep input operands as float matrices.
harness_strategy.constraint_injection: Run on Apple MPS device with float dtype; vary slice offsets, strides, and shapes while maintaining valid matmul dimensions.
harness_strategy.operation_sequence: Call torch.matmul(a, b, out=sliced_out) and inspect sliced_out after the call.
harness_strategy.oracle_construction: Compute the expected result on CPU for the same operands and use an equivalent sliced out view on CPU for comparison; flag cases where the MPS sliced out tensor is unchanged or differs from the CPU reference.
